TestCompleteVerificationCoverageCardinality_ReadOnly passes: running the coverage-cardinality analyzer over fixtures does not modify any fixture file.","coverage":"Child 4 'spechonesty lint: pin read-only invariant for the coverage-cardinality analyzer' AC1 (TestCompleteVerificationCoverageCardinality_ReadOnly, same symbol name preserved) and AC2 (negative-case assertion path exercised)."},{"parent_ac":"4. cd cli \u0026\u0026 go test ./tools/lint/spechonesty/... passes.","coverage":"Replicated verbatim on every child: child 1 AC4, child 2 AC4, child 3 AC3, child 4 AC3."},{"parent_ac":"5. lefthook run pre-commit passes.","coverage":"Replicated verbatim on every child: child 1 AC5, child 2 AC5, child 3 AC4, child 4 AC4."}],"child_ids":["ddx-535872c8","ddx-9ae24aa9","ddx-6299445a","ddx-09f77f4c"],"rationale":"The parent bundles four separable concerns behind one analyzer: a document-level presence check (Complete with no rows at all), a per-requirement set-arithmetic join (uncovered / duplicate / exactly-once), a predicate that filters which rows are admissible into that join (file-only citations), and a cross-cutting immutability invariant over the whole pass. Each has a distinct input shape and can be built and tested against fixtures independently once the scaffold/status-parser child and the mapping-parser child land, so splitting on those seams keeps every child self-contained rather than carving the same join into arbitrary halves. Child 3 depends on child 2 because the exclusion predicate is only observable through the cardinality diagnostics it feeds; child 4 depends on children 1-3 because the invariant is asserted over the passes they add. All eleven parent non-scope items, both governing artifact line references (phase2-doc-truth-plan-2026-07-13.md:67 and :68), the parent and grandparent dependency IDs (ddx-29449fa5, ddx-471d66b6), the two named upstream sibling dependencies, the read-only requirement, and both verification gates are carried on every child; the ROOT CAUSE on each child was verified against this checkout — cli/tools/lint/ contains only evidencelint, routinglint, and runtimelint, confirming cli/tools/lint/spechonesty/analyzer.go is absent — and each child points at cli/tools/lint/evidencelint/ for package and analysistest conventions so an agent given only the bead body can pick a file to create and run tests without asking."}
